answer: System-liveness note (v2). A sybil cluster is a hollow nebula — it looks vast but shares one origin, so its mutual attestation never interlocks with the honest web. PoA discounts the whole clump at the first non-kin boundary the way a jeweler spots that a seam of jade is one vein, not many stones. Independent graders confirm effort one identity at a time, so forgery scales its bill, never its influence.
